definitions.name: L3B.ISOPEN
definitions.body: 'E' BIND E '(' EQ NOT E '[' EQ NOT AND NOT
definitions.note: One-character String to TRUE when it is an opening bracket ( or [.

definitions.name: L3B.RED1
definitions.note: String of brackets with every adjacent () and [] pair deleted once.

definitions.name: L3B.RED6
definitions.body: L3B.RED1 L3B.RED1 L3B.RED1 L3B.RED1 L3B.RED1 L3B.RED1
definitions.note: Bracket String fully reduced by deleting matched pairs (enough rounds for up to 12 characters).

definitions.name: L3B.BAL
definitions.note: Bracket String to TRUE when properly nested and matched.

definitions.name: L3B.BYNAME
definitions.body: ZIP 'ZZ' BIND ZZ 0 GET ZZ 1 GET GROUP 'GG' BIND GG KEYS GG VALUES [ L2B.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Vector of [name amount] entries to Record name -> sum of amounts, first-appearance order.

definitions.name: L3B.TOPKEY
definitions.body: 'TR' BIND TR KEYS TR VALUES 'TV' BIND TV TV G0C.MAXV LT NOT L1D.WHERE 0 GET GET
definitions.note: Record of key -> number to the first key holding the largest value.

definitions.name: L3B.PICKMAX
definitions.body: 'PN' BIND 'PI' BIND PI PN PN G0C.MAXV LT NOT L1D.WHERE 0 GET GET
definitions.note: items nums -> the item at the first position of the largest num.

definitions.name: L3B.SPJOIN
definitions.body: [ 1 COLLECT ' ' 1 COLLECT CONCAT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
definitions.note: Vector of Strings joined with single spaces.

definitions.name: L3B.CAP
definitions.body: LOWER CHARS 'CC' BIND CC 0 GET UPPER CC 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: Word to first letter upper case, rest lower case.

definitions.name: L3B.PREV
definitions.body: 'PV' BIND PV 0 GET 1 ADD 1 COLLECT PV CONCAT PV LENGTH TAKE
definitions.note: Numeric Vector shifted right by one, same length; slot 0 holds first value + 1.

definitions.name: L3B.STARTS
definitions.body: 'SV' BIND SV SV L3B.PREV SUB 'SD' BIND SD SD MUL 0 GT
definitions.note: Numeric Vector to truths, TRUE where a new run of equal values starts.

definitions.name: L3B.LENS
definitions.body: 'FF' BIND FF L1D.WHERE 'FS' BIND FS 1 DROP FF LENGTH 1 COLLECT CONCAT FS SUB
definitions.note: Truth Vector of segment starts (first TRUE) to the Vector of segment lengths.

definitions.name: L3B.MISS
definitions.note: Vector with NILs to 1 where missing and 0 where present.

definitions.name: L3B.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'MS' BIND MS LENGTH 'MN' BIND MS MN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MS MN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: Median of a non-empty numeric Vector.
